search_window.basis: Last check explicitly evidenced in available run context ended at 15:50:22 PDT; subsequent hourly check receipts were not enumerable through this GitHub connection. Conservatively widened coverage rather than claiming an unverified hourly boundary.

classes_checked: Only/sole/last/full-service grocery store closure, loss, fire or disaster
Canceled or suspended emergency food distribution due to storm, flood, fire, outage or damage

excluded_examples.reason: Arvada story concerns last Safeway of a chain in the city, not its only grocery store; other grocers exist; announced before this window.
Austin co-op location closure announced before interval; a second location remains open.
